Container.Name: Ether
Container.Overview: TMDB catalogue and on-demand Usenet and debrid streaming. Supply your own providers and indexers. Optional local libraries. Open the web UI to configure Ether.

Config.Name: Configuration
Config.Description: SQLite and credentials. Prefer a local cache-pool path; network filesystems are unsuitable for the live database.

Config.Name: Segment cache
Config.Description: Segment cache; set the cache directory to /cache in setup.

Config.Name: Local media
Config.Description: Optional read-only hybrid library. Add /media in Libraries.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User Ether runs as; /config and /cache are handed to it.
